title: Nailed Decree
text:
LET IT BE KNOWN that the burning of beeswax in any chapel, house or hive is a FALSE LIGHT and an offence against the Great Wick.

Only tallow, freely given by the faithful at the Works, is blessed.

All hives in the east grove are to be burned. The keepers are to be put to the scarecrow and watched until they repent.

The scarecrow at the heart of the grove wears the grey of a Synod warden. Straw pokes out at the cuffs. It was a man once, and it has not stopped watching.
